entries.title: Light2D has no occlusion, so unexplored mine stays visible
entries.missing: A Light2D shines through solid Tilemap tiles: a miner's lamp lights the dirt behind the tunnel wall and, with the 16-lights cap, there is no fog of war or line of sight. A game whose point is exploring in the dark (Burrow Brigade) cannot keep the unseen parts black.
entries.workaround: A small lamp radius (96 world units, 20 when nearly dry), falloff 1.5 and SceneSettings.ambientLight 0.07, so the walls beyond a few tiles fall to near black. Walls next to the lamp still light up on the far side; a hand-made fog layer was not attempted in P1. P2: the fog of war grew on it: scripts/game/fog.js tracks seen tiles per miner and paints them on a second Tilemap.
entries.suggestion: Let a Light2D (or a Tilemap) opt into shadows from the solid tiles (a 2D shadow cast from Tilemap.solidTiles), or give Tilemap a per-tile 'explored' mask / fog-of-war layer that scripts can set.

entries.title: Tilemap tileset has no margin or spacing
entries.missing: Tilemap.tileset is cut into tileSize cells with no margin or spacing field. Kenney's Roguelike Caves & Dungeons sheet has a 1 px gap between tiles, so using it directly shows bleeding edges and shifted tiles.
entries.workaround: assets/src/make_atlases.py cuts the tiles out of the source sheets and re-packs them margin-free into assets/tiles_topsoil.png, tiles_crystal.png and tiles_magma.png and assets/sprites.png (run once, output committed).
entries.suggestion: Add Tilemap.margin and Tilemap.spacing (vec2, texture pixels), and the same for Sprite sheets in assets.generate_sprite_sheet / the editor tile picker.

entries.title: Changing one tile rewrites the whole Tilemap tiles array
entries.missing: Tilemap.tiles is one JSON value: digging a single tile means building and setting the full width*height array (up to 96x64 = 6144 integers here) through entity.set, and the renderer rebuilds the tilemap. There is no setTile.
entries.workaround: The shift keeps its own array, marks it dirty on every MineMap change and writes it once per frame in onLateUpdate, so several tiles dug in one frame cost one write. P2: the fog Tilemap and the flood and magma spreading rewrite tiles too, so scripts/game/fog.js and hazards.js batch their changes and write once per frame.
entries.suggestion: Expose a tile API on the Tilemap view: tilemap.setTile(tx, ty, index) / getTile, with a dirty-rect rebuild.

entries.title: Menu kit always adds the shop and the age gate
entries.missing: project.add_menu_kit creates a Shop button and panel, an age-gate script and prefab, shop strings and a purchases/ads check in main_menu.js even for a game with no store and no ads, and has no option to leave them out. validate does not complain about them but a first-time reader has to work out what to delete.
entries.workaround: Deleted the shop and age-gate files by hand, removed their imports, the shop_button handler and the 'ageGate' and 'shop' locale blocks from scripts/main_menu.js, scenes/menu.scene.json and locales/en.json.
entries.suggestion: Give project.add_menu_kit flags such as {"shop": false, "ageGate": false}, default true only when factoria.json declares purchases or ads.

entries.title: Options Controls tab lists a hard-coded jump action
entries.missing: The kit's options.js rebinding list is a fixed array ['move_left','move_right','jump','pause'] with matching options.action.* strings, so a game with other actions (dig, move_up, move_down) shows a dead 'Jump' row and no rows for its own actions until the script and locale are edited.
entries.workaround: Edited the 'actions' list in scripts/ui/options.js and added options.action.move_up, move_down and dig to locales/en.json.
entries.suggestion: Build the list from input.actions() minus the ui_* ones, taking the label from options.action.<name> and falling back to the action name.

entries.title: Per-gamepad input cannot use actions, so co-op pads are not rebindable
entries.missing: Actions bound to Gamepad* names react to ANY connected pad. For local co-op each player needs their own pad, which only input.gamepad(i).axis/down answer, with raw button and axis names; those cannot go through the Options Controls rebinding or the per-action bindings in factoria.json.
entries.workaround: scripts/game/miner_input.js has three device kinds: 'any' (the project's actions: keyboard and every pad, one player), 'keys' (a fixed key block) and 'pad' (input.gamepad(i) with hard-coded left stick, d-pad and A/X). P2 added the torch button (B or Y on a pad, T on the keyboard) to the same three device kinds.
entries.suggestion: Per-player action sets: input.gamepad(i).down('dig') resolving the project's binding for that action, or input.player(i).axis(...) with a rebind per player.

entries.title: assets.synth_sound presets come out much louder than the validator accepts
entries.missing: Sounds from assets.synth_sound (ore, oil, lamp_out, rescue) measure between -3.8 and -7 LUFS, so 'factoria validate' warns 'very loud' and that they differ by 16 LU from the quieter presets.
entries.workaround: Set defaults.audio {normalize: true, targetLufs: -18} in assets.json so every effect plays at the same loudness.
entries.suggestion: Have synth_sound normalise its output to about -18 LUFS, or write the normalize import setting to assets.json itself.

entries.title: Light2D is capped at 16 per frame
entries.missing: Only 16 Light2D reach the shader per frame; more are dropped with no message and no way to choose which. A mine with torches, crystals and four miners' lamps goes past 16 at once.
entries.workaround: scripts/game/lights.js keeps a pool of 16 minus one per miner and gives it to the sources nearest the miners, switching the others off; tests count the active Light2D entities.
entries.suggestion: Pick the 16 lights that matter on the engine side (nearest the camera, brightest) and say so in the Light2D docs; or raise the cap with a tiled/clustered 2D lighting pass.

entries.title: renderStats().lights does not count Light2D
entries.missing: factoria:test renderStats().lights counts only 3D lights, so a test cannot assert how many Light2D are drawn or that the cap of 16 holds.
entries.workaround: tests/helpers/world.js activeLights() counts the active entities that carry a Light2D component instead of the lights the renderer uses.
entries.suggestion: Add lights2d (counted) and lights2dDropped to renderStats().

entries.title: No 2D or tile pathfinding
entries.missing: The engine has no path search for tile maps: enemies that chase a miner through tunnels that change as the miners dig need A* on the Tilemap that reacts to edits.
entries.workaround: scripts/game/pathfinding.js: A* over the mine grid (with dig cost, danger tiles, a path follower and a nav.version counter that tells followers when digging changed the map); tested in tests/pathfinding.test.js.
entries.suggestion: A nav module: nav.findPath(tilemap, from, to, opts) with a passable callback and an invalidation counter fed by Tilemap edits.

entries.title: No behaviour tree or other AI module
entries.missing: The engine has no AI building blocks: enemies need sequences, selectors, cooldowns and interruption, and every game has to write them.
entries.workaround: scripts/game/behavior_tree.js is a small generic tree (sequence, selector, condition, action with hooks, wait, cooldown, inverter, succeeder); scripts/game/enemy_brains.js builds the beetle, thief and Mole King trees on it.
entries.suggestion: Ship a behaviour-tree helper in the scripting module, or document the pattern in AI_GUIDE.md.

entries.title: Audio docs do not say a scene load stops the music
entries.missing: docs/AUDIO.md and the audio API say nothing about audio.music after a scene load. Only a paragraph on scene editing in AI_GUIDE.md says loading a scene stops the audio, so a track started in one scene silently ends in the next.
entries.workaround: scripts/game/music.js starts the stratum's track at every shift (play() always calls audio.music) and reports whether the track changed.
entries.suggestion: Say in the audio.music doc string and in AUDIO.md what a scene load does to music, and offer a persistent music option.

entries.title: Scripts cannot read or write the system clipboard
entries.missing: No clipboard API in the factoria module and no paste shortcut in TextField, so a seed code cannot be copied to another program or pasted from one
entries.workaround: scripts/game/clipboard.js keeps a session buffer behind copy()/paste() and a useSystem({write,read}) hook; the camp and results say honestly when the code only stayed in the game; the title has a Paste button that reads the buffer
entries.suggestion: clipboard.read()/clipboard.write(text) in the factoria module (async on web), and Ctrl+V / Cmd+V in a focused TextField

entries.title: game.today() has no time of day, so the UTC date is not derivable
entries.missing: game.today() answers the local calendar date and utcOffsetMinutes, but no hour or minute, so a daily seed that must roll over at the same instant for every player (UTC midnight) cannot be computed
entries.workaround: scripts/game/daily.js keys the daily dig on the local date (game.today().iso); players in other time zones roll over at their own midnight, and the README says so
entries.suggestion: add utcIso (the UTC date) or hour/minute to game.today(), still fixed by game.setDate in tests

entries.title: platform.cloud has no modified time or conflict signal
entries.missing: cloud.load answers only the value: no modified time, device id or conflict notice, so two devices that played offline cannot be told apart by the store
entries.workaround: scripts/game/cloud.js stores a revision counter in every save and the revision last synced per slot (burrow.cloudBase.N), settles a conflict by play time and keeps the loser as burrow.backup.N
entries.suggestion: cloud.stat(key) answering { modified, size } and a conflict event where the store has one (Steam Cloud, iCloud)

entries.title: game.click on a widget of a panel opened in the same frame silently does nothing
entries.missing: Right after a panel becomes active, ui.rectOf answers the default rectangle until one game.step has laid it out, and game.click(id) then hits nothing without any message
entries.workaround: tests step twice after opening a panel before clicking in it (tests/cloud.test.js, tests/saves.test.js)
entries.suggestion: game.click throws 'widget not laid out yet: step once after activating it'
